stages.title: 鏈與邏輯係數
stages.description: 建立原始係數、鏈係數、縮放係數三張對照表，記錄鏈外收益也一起縮小。 依案例來源只註記可查證的裝置／方法；另以虛線標出本課新增的簡化假設。
stages.descriptionEn: Build original, chain and scaled coefficient tables, noting that non-chain objectives shrink too. Use the source only to label documented devices or methods; mark this exercise's simplifying assumptions with dashed connections.
